# Dr Xiaoxiong Xie

::: {.position}
Lecturer in Building Engineering\
University of Plymouth, UK
:::

::: {.generated-profile-links}
:::
:::

::: {.profile-bio}
I study the interactions between **buildings, urban climate and energy systems**, with a focus on energy demand, thermal environments and climate resilience. My research asks how a building's urban surroundings affect its performance, and how heating and cooling technologies, in turn, change outdoor conditions.

My work combines building energy simulation and urban climate modelling, particularly **[SUEWS](https://suews.io/)–EnergyPlus coupling**. I examine how local weather, urban form and heat exchange influence natural ventilation, indoor overheating and the performance of low-carbon heating and cooling systems.

I apply these methods to **climate-resilient building retrofit**, including social housing through the [UMAR project](projects/index.qmd#umar). I also contribute to collaborative studies of urban thermal exposure and environmental monitoring.

:::
:::
